data.action: 双手背在身后回首傲娇娇嗔，夏裙微扬
data.description: 【惣流·明日香 · 夏日黄色连衣裙】烈日炎炎的盛夏高架电车月台上，蝉鸣在炽热空气中回响。明日香身着一袭明艳娇嫩的黄色吊带连衣裙，双手背在身后，微风掀起明黄色的裙摆露出修长白皙的美腿。她微微侧身回头，眼神中带着三分娇嗔与七分骄傲——「笨蛋真嗣！连电车时间都记不住，待会可别指望本小姐在路上等你！」
data.lighting: 盛夏炽烈阳光与清透蓝天光照
data.location: 第3新东京市高架列车月台
data.promptProse: Asuka waits on the elevated summer train platform in her yellow sundress, both hands behind her back as she turns with a proud, mildly impatient glance toward Shinji. Her twin tails and skirt move in the breeze. The eye-level medium view shows platform markings beneath and overhead rail structures receding behind. Strong summer sunlight brightens the yellow fabric, with blue-sky reflections softening shade under her turned face.
data.title: 惣流·明日香 · 夏日黄色连衣裙
